title: Deeplus R51f3 normalized module API digest

module_id.description: Resolved (PackageId, ModulePath) identity; never inferred from the filesystem path alone.

actor_protocol_binding_tables.description: Sorted common/public Actor Protocol binding tables. Private tables are implementation-only.

responsibilityEvidenceApiDescriptor.description: Stable type-level responsibility policy and witness residue. Value-level evidence, owner, region, destination and source-origin identities are forbidden from the module API digest.

x-deeplus-shared-mutex-payload-bound-con.bound_residue: type_parameter_predicate_bounds contains exactly one row for parameter T and predicate SharedMutexPayloadAdmitted on the SharedMutex declaration; a generic public declaration that constructs or accepts an otherwise-unproven SharedMutex<T> retains the same bound row
x-deeplus-shared-mutex-payload-bound-con.canonical_order: strict ascending Unicode scalar order by (parameter_id,predicate_id), with no duplicates
x-deeplus-shared-mutex-payload-bound-con.normalized_signature_binding: the normalized signature and structured predicate-bound rows must agree exactly

x-deeplus-symbol-id-contract.uniqueness: all symbol_id values are pairwise distinct; duplicate IDs are rejected even when the remaining symbol payload differs
x-deeplus-symbol-id-contract.ordering: strict ascending Unicode scalar sequence order by symbol_id

x-deeplus-named-pack-residue-contract.api_identity: normalized_row_digest and witness_digest are mandatory whenever named_rest_residue is non-null
x-deeplus-named-pack-residue-contract.separation: named-rest row requirements are distinct from callable requires clauses

x-deeplus-trait-language-role-contract.identity: TraitLanguageRoleId is distinct from TraitId, ConformanceId and TraitWitnessId
x-deeplus-trait-language-role-contract.export_rule: every exported role-bearing Trait type row carries a non-null trait_language_role
x-deeplus-trait-language-role-contract.api_breaking_change: adding, removing or changing role_id changes the public API digest
x-deeplus-trait-language-role-contract.operator_fence: TRAIT_LANGUAGE_ROLE_OPERATOR_R1 classifies only the closed thirteen-glyph law and cannot select or widen glyphs

x-deeplus-type-header-cleanup-budget-con.presence: required for every cleanup-bearing public type; omitted for a public type with no cleanup residue
x-deeplus-type-header-cleanup-budget-con.import_admission: exact canonical envelope digest and effective rows must agree

x-deeplus-function-static-activation-con.absence: an absent or null function_static_activation field means activation_present=false; existing callable canonical bytes need not add a null member
x-deeplus-function-static-activation-con.presence_owner: only kind=function or kind=method with synchronous, cancellation-forbidden ordinary or pure callable profile
x-deeplus-function-static-activation-con.identity_domain: CallableImplementationId is semantic and target-independent; FunctionStaticOwnerId is computed per normalized instantiation and is not a machine address
x-deeplus-function-static-activation-con.recipe_collision: equal FunctionStaticOwnerId with unequal canonical owner recipes is a terminal link error
x-deeplus-function-static-activation-con.helper_dependency_rule: every helper is statically selected, activation_present=false, and bound to its safety_summary_sha256
x-deeplus-function-static-activation-con.public_residue: the public digest contains semantic recipe/digest/failure/publication residue only
x-deeplus-function-static-activation-con.backend_local_residue: initializer symbols, bytecode entries, state-cell addresses, table indices, and machine-code identities belong to implementation/link artifacts and are forbidden here

x-deeplus-nonescaping-lexical-access-con.public_identity: RegionId, CapturePlanId, CaptureFieldId, EvalId, MIR value/place/loan/reservation/cleanup/construction/closure identities, and ancestor-place identities are local value/proof artifacts and never enter a module API digest.
x-deeplus-nonescaping-lexical-access-con.callable_signature: A callable signature continues to expose its ordinary responsibility profile; nonescaping lexical residence does not become a public calling convention or an exported capture environment.
x-deeplus-nonescaping-lexical-access-con.export_rule: An exported or escaping callable must be FrameIndependent. A RegionBound local callable is rejected before API digest construction.

x-deeplus-closure-capture-plan-api-fence.public_residue: An exported callable exposes only its ordinary normalized signature/type and responsibility channels; closure capture plans and environment layout are private implementation semantics.
x-deeplus-closure-capture-plan-api-fence.frame_rule: Every exported or escaping callable is FrameIndependent; RegionBound capture environments are rejected before digest construction.

x-deeplus-fixed-operator-conformance-con.absence: an absent or null fixed_operator_conformance field means the conformance is not a fixed-glyph dispatch provider
x-deeplus-fixed-operator-conformance-con.presence_owner: only kind=conformance under the Stable exact 13-role unary/arithmetic/equality/total-order profile
x-deeplus-fixed-operator-conformance-con.selection_identity: OperatorId plus normalized operand identities selects one left-owner DIRECT_GLOBAL ConformanceId/WitnessId/MethodId/substitution and then derives associated arithmetic OutputTypeId or fixed Bool comparison output
x-deeplus-fixed-operator-conformance-con.intrinsic_reservation: an intrinsic-reserved operand pair has no user fixed_operator_conformance residue and cannot be overridden
x-deeplus-fixed-operator-conformance-con.derived_projection: BinaryNotEqual shares Eq.equals with BinaryEqual; all four order glyphs share Ord.compare; compound assignment and range have no independent hook
x-deeplus-fixed-operator-conformance-con.arithmetic_terminal: ArithmeticDefect is a nonrecoverable precommit terminal and is not a throws member

x-deeplus-callable-channel-id-contract.scope: for each function or method, collect every non-null receiver channel plus every parameters, result, and captures channel
x-deeplus-callable-channel-id-contract.uniqueness: all collected channel_id values are pairwise distinct across the complete callable responsibility profile

x-deeplus-run-reply-responsibility-contr.nominal_separation: Run<T> is a ConcurId-owned structured execution handle; Reply<T> is a post-admission actor reply handle, and neither implicitly or explicitly converts to the other
x-deeplus-run-reply-responsibility-contr.normalized_handler_error_set_order: strict ascending Unicode scalar sequence with no duplicates
x-deeplus-run-reply-responsibility-contr.compatibility_storage_and_await: preserve ReplyResponsibility on every Reply<T> value; require exact normalized static-field equality except when an explicit admitted error-set-subsumption proof widens normalized_handler_error_set; preserve each value's ReplyId and correlation_id without erasure or forgery
x-deeplus-run-reply-responsibility-contr.api_export: every responsibility channel whose type_identity contains Reply<T> carries reply_responsibility in canonical bytes; any channel whose type_identity contains owner-bound Run<T> is rejected
x-deeplus-run-reply-responsibility-contr.module_api_identity_fields: reply_id and correlation_id store the constant policy marker per_value_non_forgeable rather than runtime identities; each admitted Reply value receives concrete ReplyId and correlation identity in typed-HIR/MIR residue

x-deeplus-responsibility-evidence-contra.identity_separation: ResponsibilityRuleId is disjoint from callable ResponsibilityProfileId; value-level ResponsibilityEvidenceId is intentionally not exported
x-deeplus-responsibility-evidence-contra.selection_rule: Export only the stable normalized type-level policy and exact selected Trait witness/error/effect residue; runtime or backend relookup is forbidden

x-deeplus-canonical-byte-algorithm.precondition: validate the closed schema, kind-field contracts, pairwise symbol_id uniqueness, strict symbol order, and sorted unique set-like rows before hashing
x-deeplus-canonical-byte-algorithm.symbol_order: strict ascending Unicode scalar sequence by symbol_id
x-deeplus-canonical-byte-algorithm.set_order: strict ascending Unicode scalar sequence with no duplicates
x-deeplus-canonical-byte-algorithm.responsibility_evidence_descriptor_order: strict ascending tuple (responsibility_rule_id,type_id,evidence_kind,trait_witness_id_or_null with null before strings)
x-deeplus-canonical-byte-algorithm.object_member_order: ascending Unicode scalar sequence by member name at every object depth
x-deeplus-canonical-byte-algorithm.string_encoding: emit JSON mandatory escapes for quotation mark, reverse solidus, and U+0000..U+001F; emit every other Unicode scalar directly as UTF-8 without normalization
steps: remove exactly the top-level canonical_sha256 member
sort symbols by symbol_id and each declared set-like row by Unicode scalar sequence
sort actor_protocol_binding_tables by table_id and each binding row by (requirement_id, binding_id)
serialize object members in Unicode-scalar key order using comma and colon separators without spaces
encode the resulting JSON text as UTF-8 and SHA-256 those bytes

x-deeplus-actor-protocol-binding-profile.api_projection_relation: exact byte-identical common/public filter of the MODULE_IMPLEMENTATION table set

x-deeplus-actor-protocol-binding-contrac.table_order: strict ascending Unicode scalar sequence by table_id

x-deeplus-loan-close-private-residue.public_residue: existing source-level borrow and inout responsibility only
